description.en: An old meeting house with a busy assembly room. Someone inside has strong opinions about the accounts.
description.zh-CN: 一座热闹的老会馆。听起来，里面有人对账目很有意见。

description.en: Ledgers and maps cover the long table. Scuff marks run across the open floor.
description.zh-CN: 长桌上铺着账簿和地图。空地上留着一道道脚步擦痕。

description.en: Enter the assembly room at Stonebridge Hall.
description.zh-CN: 进入石桥会馆的议事厅。

description.en: Isis is waiting for your answer about the guarded gold.
description.zh-CN: 伊西斯正等你答复，是否准备好带走守卫看管的黄金。

text.en: Is this Stonebridge Hall?
text.zh-CN: 这里是石桥会馆吗？

text.en: It is. Who's asking?
text.zh-CN: 是的。请问你是？

text.en: Horus. I'm looking for my mother, Isis.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯。我来找母亲伊西斯。

text.en: That narrows it down. What brought you here?
text.zh-CN: 这就好找了。你们有什么事？

text.en: The gold she recovered. I'd like to know who's getting it back.
text.zh-CN: 她追回的那批黄金。我想知道要交还给谁。

text.en: Come inside. I'll let her know you're here.
text.zh-CN: 请进。我去告诉她，你们到了。

text.en: Please tell Mother I need a word about the parcel.
text.zh-CN: 请告诉母亲，我想问问包裹的事。

text.en: She's checking the accounts. She won't be long.
text.zh-CN: 她在核对账目，应该很快就来。

text.en: Then I'll leave word with you. We shouldn't keep you from your work.
text.zh-CN: 那就请你代为传话。我们也不好一直耽误你做事。

text.en: Horus. I knew you'd find the place eventually.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯。我就知道，你总能找到这里。

text.en: Your directions were suspiciously short, Mother.
text.zh-CN: 母亲，你指路时说得未免太省事了。

text.en: You followed them, didn't you?
text.zh-CN: 你不是已经找到了吗？

text.en: We came to make sure the gold reaches its owners.
text.zh-CN: 我们来确认，黄金会交到失主手里。

text.en: (Isis catches Horus by the sleeve before he can leave.)
text.zh-CN: （伊西斯在荷鲁斯转身前，拉住了他的衣袖。）

text.en: What is it?
text.zh-CN: 怎么了？

text.en: Stay for supper, Horus. Even heroes can survive one meal with their mother.
text.zh-CN: 留下吃顿饭吧，荷鲁斯。就算是英雄，陪母亲吃顿饭也不至于有事。

text.en: (Isis smiles and pulls up another chair.)
text.zh-CN: （伊西斯笑着，又拉过一把椅子。）

text.en: All right. Supper first, then the gold.
text.zh-CN: 好吧。先吃饭，再说黄金。

text.en: (They spend the evening over food, maps, and several disputed family stories.)
text.zh-CN: （这一晚，大家围着饭菜和地图，听了几段各有不同版本的家庭往事。）

text.en: Morning already? That sounds like an argument in the hall.
text.zh-CN: 天已经亮了？前厅好像有人在争论。

text.en: You can't simply walk in and demand a chest of gold.
text.zh-CN: 你不能一进门，就要求带走一箱黄金。

text.en: It's stolen relief money. The villages can't eat a receipt.
text.zh-CN: 那是被劫的救济款。村民可不能拿收据当饭吃。

text.en: (She spots Horus.) Horus? Remember who always brought extra food to the festivals?
text.zh-CN: （她看见荷鲁斯。）荷鲁斯？还记得谁总在节庆时多带些吃的吗？

text.en: Hathor! You never let anyone leave hungry.
text.zh-CN: 哈索尔！你从不让人空着肚子离开。

text.en: Someone had to balance out your taste for heroics.
text.zh-CN: 总得有人照顾一下，免得大家都只顾着当英雄。

text.en: So you know the claimant. That doesn't settle the claim.
text.zh-CN: 原来你认识来领款的人。可光认识，还不能把账结清。

text.en: Then let us hear it properly. What happened to the gold?
text.zh-CN: 那就把事情说清楚。这批黄金到底出了什么事？

text.en: I recovered it from thieves. It's under my seal until someone can get it safely home.
text.zh-CN: 我从窃贼那里追回了它。在有人能把它安全送回去之前，先由我封存。

text.en: Sounds like we need fewer speeches and a delivery plan.
text.zh-CN: 看来，咱们需要少说几句，多想想怎么把东西送回去。

text.en: Get ready, then. If you want to carry it out, you'll have to get past the hall's guardians.
text.zh-CN: 那就做好准备。想把它带走，得先过会馆守卫这一关。

text.en: The gold is ready. Are you ready for the guardians?
text.zh-CN: 黄金就在这里。你准备好面对守卫了吗？

text.en: Those guardians don't give much ground.
text.zh-CN: 这些守卫，真是寸步不让。

text.en: Every step is covered. We need a better angle.
text.zh-CN: 每一步都有人照应。我们得换个角度。

text.en: Then stop charging the center. Watch the gaps between the guards.
text.zh-CN: 那就别只顾着往中间冲。看看守卫之间的空隙。

text.en: A helper? Bes, call the rest of them.
text.zh-CN: 来了帮手？贝斯，叫其他人过来。

text.en: One signal. Everyone to their posts!
text.zh-CN: 信号一响，全员就位！

text.en: I was hoping the signal meant lunch.
text.zh-CN: 我还以为，那是开饭的信号。

text.en: You'll have to finish the trial before you get another meal.
text.zh-CN: 想再吃一顿，先把考验完成再说。

text.en: That extra formation kept getting in its own way.
text.zh-CN: 后面加上的那套阵势，倒一直在挡自己的路。

text.en: All right. Can we get these supplies back to their owners now?
text.zh-CN: 好了。现在能把这些补给送回失主手里了吗？

text.en: Mother, we'll take the gold to Hathor's people.
text.zh-CN: 母亲，我们会把黄金送去给哈索尔那边的人。

text.en: Isis, come with us. A sensible adult might keep the rest of us out of trouble.
text.zh-CN: 伊西斯，和我们同行吧。有个稳妥的大人在，剩下的人也能少惹点事。

text.en: Please. I'd rather have you beside us than negotiating from another town.
text.zh-CN: 一起走吧。我宁可你在身边，也不想再隔着一座城找你商量。

text.en: (Isis nods.)
text.zh-CN: （伊西斯点了点头。）

text.en: A treasure map too? Is this where you tell us to follow three cryptic landmarks?
text.zh-CN: 还有藏宝图？接下来，是不是要让我们找三个谜一样的地标？

text.en: If I knew the exact spot, Horus wouldn't still be arguing with that map.
text.zh-CN: 我要是知道确切地点，荷鲁斯也不用一直和那张图较劲了。

text.en: (You decide not to ask who drew it.)
text.zh-CN: （你决定，还是别问这图是谁画的了。）
